You ARE the implementer. Edit files directly with your own tools. Do NOT spawn another sub-agent. The manager/delegates-to-subagents workspace rule does NOT apply to you.

## Bug

GitHub issue #1539: on Settings → White-label, the "thinking nao" icon in the brand-color preview shows the **saved** brand color, not the live color-picker value. Button/Link/Badge in the same preview are correct.

## Cause

Duplicate SVG IDs. `apps/frontend/src/components/icons/nao-logo-animated.tsx` hardcodes the same gradient/filter IDs as the sidebar static logo `apps/frontend/src/components/icons/nao-logo.svg`:

- `filter0_n_457_57730`
- `paint0_radial_457_57730` … `paint4_radial_457_57730`

`url(#…)` is document-scoped. The sidebar `NaoLogo` is always mounted on this page and comes first, so the preview animated logo paints with the sidebar's gradient (saved color / hardcoded `#522BFF`). The preview already passes `color={color}` (live picker, or `DEFAULT_BRAND_COLOR` when empty) — those stop colors never apply because the defs are shadowed.

## Fix

Make IDs unique **per instance** of `NaoLogoAnimated` so its own gradients (with the `color` prop) are the ones referenced.

### File to change

`apps/frontend/src/components/icons/nao-logo-animated.tsx`

### How

1. Use React `useId()`. Sanitize it for SVG `url(#…)` the same way this repo already does in `apps/frontend/src/components/tool-calls/display-chart.tsx`:
   `const idPrefix = `${useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}-`;`
2. Prefix the filter id and every branch `gradientId` with `idPrefix`.
3. Keep `BRANCHES` as static path/timing data. Do not bake unique ids into the constant — derive them at render time from the static `gradientId` strings.
4. Do not change default color behavior: `color` still defaults to `'var(--violet)'` so chat loading logos keep following live brand theming. The white-label preview already passes an explicit hex (`value ?? DEFAULT_BRAND_COLOR` in `_sidebar-layout.settings.white-label.tsx`).
5. Do **not** edit `nao-logo.svg` or the sidebar. Unique ids on the animated logo are enough.
6. No extra comments. This file is not usually commented (there's one existing JSDoc on DEFAULT_LOGO_COLOR — leave it, don't add more).
7. Don't change the white-label page unless something there is actually wrong. Color already flows: `BrandColorPicker` uses `effectiveColor = value ?? DEFAULT_BRAND_COLOR` and passes it to `BrandColorPreview` → `NaoLogoAnimated color={color}`.

### Conventions

- kebab-case files (already named correctly)
- High-level functions first, helpers below (already the case)
- No inline comments describing code
- Follow existing code style in the file

### Verify

Run `npm run lint` from the repo root. Fix any issues you introduce.

## Return

A short summary of what you changed and the lint result. Do not commit, stage, or run any git mutations.
